notes: Sourced from Brompton Technology's official Tessera S8 datasheet (March 2025 revision, PDF fetched directly from bromptontech.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Brompton-S8-Data-Sheet-Mar2025-EN.pdf). Rear-panel port layout and labels (DMX In & Thru, Tessera 1G Outputs 1-8, Management Ethernet x2, Local UI with USB 3.0 x2 + DisplayPort, 12G-SDI In & Thru, HDMI 2.0b In, Bi/Tri-Level Sync In & Thru, Switched Auto Ranging Mains Input) taken from the labeled rear-panel diagram in the datasheet; the full spec table on page 4 confirms bandwidths/versions. Front panel adds 2x USB 2.0 Type-A. DisplayPort version is not stated in the datasheet (only "DisplayPort (DP++)"), so grade was omitted per the omission rule. Genlock/sync and DMX ports intentionally left ungraded since they fall outside the graded connector categories. AC inlet is a standard IEC-style socket per the rear diagram; the datasheet does not name the exact IEC sub-type (C13/C14), so it is mapped to the generic "iec". Device classified as category "converter" / type "Encoder/Decoder" since it is an LED video/pixel-data processor rather than a display, switcher, or matrix router -- no better-fitting category exists in the provided enum. Rack size is 2U based on the 88.9mm (3.5") unboxed height.

ports.name: HDMI In
ports.note: HDMI 2.0b input, full 18Gbps bandwidth, up to 4096x2160, compatible with DVI-D and DisplayPort sources via adapters

ports.name: SDI In
ports.note: 12G-SDI input supporting HD-SDI/3G-SDI/6G-SDI/12G-SDI (ST-292/424/2081/2082 2SI), up to 4096x2160, 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2

ports.name: SDI Thru
ports.note: Re-clocked loop-through of the 12G-SDI input signal

ports.name: Tessera Output 1
ports.note: 1 Gigabit Ethernet Tessera output, nominal 525K pixels @ 8-bit, 60Hz; supports closed loop redundancy

ports.name: Management Ethernet 1
ports.note: Gigabit Ethernet management network port for Tessera Remote software

ports.name: DMX In
ports.note: DMX-512A on 5-pin XLR, also carries Art-Net/sACN eDMX control

ports.name: Sync In
ports.note: Bi-level / Tri-level genlock sync input; no bandwidth grade applies to sync/reference signals

ports.name: Local UI DisplayPort
ports.note: DisplayPort++ local monitor output for on-box UI; supports HDMI, DVI and VGA via adapter, up to 3840x2160. Version not stated in datasheet.

ports.name: Local UI USB 3.0 (rear, 1)
ports.note: Rear USB 3.0 Type-A for local keyboard/mouse

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Switched auto-ranging IEC power inlet, 100-240V AC, 50-60Hz, 1.2-0.6A
